profile.name: Muhammad Radya Iftikhar
profile.headline: Informatics student focused on Data Engineering, with a foundation in Python, SQL, and web development.
profile.aboutHeadline: From web development to data engineering.
about: Hi, I'm Radya. I'm a fifth-semester Informatics student at Universitas Muhammadiyah Malang (class of 2024) with a GPA of 3.91, and a graduate of SMK Telkom Malang, majoring in Software Engineering.

I started out in web development, then grew curious about the data side: how data is collected, cleaned, and delivered so it's ready to use. Right now I'm deepening my Data Engineering skills with Python and SQL.

On campus, I work as a laboratory assistant for various practical courses, from Data Structures and Programming Algorithms to Computer Networks. I also completed a six-month SEO Specialist internship at Indobot Academy, where I got used to reading website performance data. I'm currently looking for a Data Engineering internship starting from my sixth-semester break.

points: Assist students in practical sessions for Data Structures, Programming Algorithms, Computer Networks, and various other lab-based courses.
Explain course material and help students debug their code in person during lab sessions.
Help prepare lab modules and exercises, and grade practical assignments.
Conducted keyword research and on-page optimization for website pages.
Analyzed website performance with Google Search Console and Google Analytics to identify improvement opportunities.
Prepared regular SEO reports and content improvement recommendations.
